tagline: The 37th Marmaris International Race Week: two training days, five race days and three race formats — from starts in the bay to an offshore race of 35–50 miles. A racing yacht with three professionals in the crew.

itinerary.title: Marmaris Race Week, day by day
itinerary.intro: The 37th Marmaris International Race Week: a week on the waters of Marmaris Bay, around 150–200 yachts and sailors from all over the world. We sail a racing yacht: three professionals in the crew, the rest amateurs who already have sailing experience.

days.label: Days 1–2
days.title: Training
days.text: Two full days on the water: we get to grips with the racing yacht, assign roles, practise sail hoists and bring the crew together before the starts.

days.label: Days 3–7
days.title: Race days
days.text: Five scoring days in three formats: inshore — course races in Marmaris Bay, coastal — short passage races along the coast, and offshore — a long race of 35 or 50 nautical miles.

itinerary.note: Our goals: to have a great time, to teach amateurs to handle a big yacht and to fight for a podium place. We book the yacht about three months before the start. You can live on the yacht, but it is more comfortable to rent a hotel or a house ashore for the whole team.
